context: Continuous selling on 28 Sep on all three indices after a very big momentum, so the sellers from above have booked and left, and the late ones hold little quantity.
plan: SAME BRANCHES AS 28 SEP, NEW REASON: flat to gap-down still means SELL and a gap up BUY. Monday's sellers were driven out by a breakout; tonight's have booked their profit. Either way nobody is seated above to hunt.

FLAT TO GAP DOWN -> SELL, WITH THE MARKET: the upper sellers cannot be targeted -- they booked after a very big momentum, and the late ones hold little quantity; identify selling-side setups. A follow, not a hunt.
GAP UP -> BUY: after a big momentum the market has gone a little sideways; a direct gap up may be it trying something different, and can set a trap -- so identify buying-side setups there.

BOTH EXPIRE TODAY (not in his video): NIFTY's weekly and BankNIFTY's monthly contracts expire on 29 Sep -- the two-expiry day that TWO EXPIRIES AT ONCE MULTIPLY THE TRAPS (v4o) warns alternates traps.
